text:
I’m a passionate, hard-working developer with 7 years of experience building polished web apps, and I’d love to help with your NextJS chat product.

Your project is a strong fit for my background because I’ve worked on both real-time chat experiences and Next.js/Tailwind builds that needed to feel fast, responsive, and reliable. In particular, I built a Streaming chat widget for Quillstack in edtech, where I created the front end and Node proxy for a tutoring chat that streams answers token by token. The result was first token on screen in about 600 ms, supporting 30k chats a month. That work required careful handling of streaming UI behavior, state management, and a smooth user experience under real usage.

I also rebuilt a Home goods storefront for Juniper & Ash Home using Next.js and Tailwind CSS, replacing a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront and CMS the marketing team could edit themselves. That project improved the largest contentful paint from 4.1s to 1.3s and increased organic traffic by 38% in 3 months. It’s a good example of the kind of responsive, production-focused front end work I bring to a team.

For your chat app, I can contribute across the areas you mentioned: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, error handling, authentication flows, responsive desktop/mobile layouts, and building user interfaces that feel clean and intuitive. I’m comfortable working in a full stack environment as needed, and I care a lot about making the front end robust when dealing with real-time interactions and session-based experiences.

I’m available for 20 hours per week and would be glad to support the project over the next 6 months. If you’re looking for someone who can move steadily, communicate clearly, and keep the UI solid as the product grows, I’d be happy to talk further.
